Button · equal label across seven states
Button · long label, fill and explicit icon colour

Observed: 28 Button variants keep 111 × 48 px with the same label; 14 Search variants expose editable text and canonical colour roles. Search wraps help at 240/600 px; long values truncate. Twenty environment instances and the input catalogue instance retain master 247:9.
Migration: Search Label#247:0 → Label#314:6 after Figma created set 314:286. Original master 247:9 remains. Superseded anatomy is preserved at 314:82 on the Universal Masters page.

Follow-up implemented: Button/Field canonical theme migration and contextual foreground inheritance for the 24 preferred original icons. See Theme QA board 322:262. Still unverified: arbitrary external icons, runtime keyboard/screen-reader behaviour, text enlargement, native Apple adapters and independent evaluation.

Usage: retain visible labels; use native button and search-input semantics. Clear keeps focus in the input. Associate help/error text, announce result counts and busy status, and retain the query on failure. Use static busy feedback for reduced motion and opaque surfaces by default.

Meridian uses primitive colours, semantic roles and contextual mappings. Ten canonical environments share the same component geometry. Environment and Appearance are independent collections; Dawn and Dusk are appearance modes.

39 public semantic variables cover action, background, border, focus, links, status, text and ambient materials. Use roles instead of raw colours. The canonical Environment collection resolves through Appearance aliases to primitives.
